dependency_edges.handoff: Drug categories and six county classes define the random-walk state.
Simulated states feed the spatial-autocorrelation error and coefficient tuning.
ACS predictors and county classes feed the random-forest augmentation.
Random-forest probabilities initialize the socioeconomic random walk.
The non-SES random walk feeds the backward origin search.
County outcomes, ACS predictors, and adjacency feed spatial regression.
Initial spatial failures feed numerical repair and diagnostics.
Fitted yearly spatial models feed impact and sensitivity comparisons.
Random-walk forecasts feed the medium-horizon and concern interfaces.
Spatial impacts and near-term forecasts feed strategy and memo claims.
